    Elves¶

    One of the Six Main Races of Ge'or — an ancient, graceful humanoid species that once ruled the world during the Elvish Age. Elves are nature-attuned, long-lived, and the only species the Shadows cannot control: their minds are genetically closed to Hybrian hivemind absorption, which is why the Shadows engineered centuries of hatred against them.

    Biology¶

    • Appearance: Tall, graceful, with pointed ears and ageless features. Nature-attuned bearing
    • Lifespan: Up to 400 years — the longest of the main races
    • Reproduction: 3–4 children per elf — their population can scale quickly when conditions allow
    • Mage-cell expression: High. Elven magic is nature-attuned, expressed through the gardens, mazes, and living art they are famous for
    • Traits: Genetic immunity — elves cannot be absorbed into the Hybrian hivemind, cannot be mind-read, and cannot be converted into Shadow puppets. Their minds are closed

    Society¶

    Elven society is patient, nature-worshiping, and deliberately slow — measured in decades where other species measure in days.

    • Governance: Reclusive kingdoms and refuge states: Elvennrin in Central Erisdar, Elvenkrad in North Erisdar, Luzia and Maemon on Merratodoni, New Elvengar on Kutten, and the elven/halfling nation of Barro and Kob
    • Culture: Nature-worship and a carnivore ethic. Patient wisdom; elves do not rush decisions that will outlive them. Their art — gardens, mazes, living architecture — was legendary across Erisdar during their golden age
    • Disposition: Not warmongers — elves fight only to defend
    • Relations: Rivalry with Dwarves — a healthy, complementary friendship of nature and industry is possible. They tolerate Humans with polite condescension. They ally with anyone who fights the Shadows
    • History: Golden age under Elvengar in Age 6; shattered by the Hybrian crash, the Great Divergence, the Kutten Catastrophe, and the Great Elvish Persecution (137 AGD) — all engineered or exploited by the Shadows

    Genetic Immunity¶

    Elves cannot be absorbed into the Hybrian hivemind. During The Last Great War, they genetically modified themselves to resist Shadow brainwashing and information extraction. An elf cannot be turned, cannot be mind-read, cannot be converted into a Shadow puppet. Their minds are closed.

    This is why the Shadows engineered the myth of elven evil. This is why the Erisian church — a Shadow creation — institutionalized elven hatred. It was never about theology. It was about eliminating the one species the Shadows cannot control.

    Golden Age¶

    During Age 6, known as the Elvish Age, the elves rose to dominance across Ge'or. Elvengar expanded from Kutten to conquer parts of the Demon Continent and West Erisdar. While other species struggled with post-Romanium poverty, the elves thrived — their nature-attuned culture did not depend on mines and industry. They built gardens, mazes, and art of legendary beauty across all Erisdar. The golden age ended when the Hybrian ship crashed in Pontus in 2989 BGD, triggering human invasions that pushed the elves back to Kutten.

    History¶

    • Elvengar — First great elven kingdom, destroyed in the Great Divergence (Year 0) and the subsequent Kutten Catastrophe.
    • Great Elvish Persecution (137 AGD) — Systematic campaign by the Erisian church against elven survivors. A Shadow operation.
    • The Elvish Diaspora — Survivors scattered across Ge'or, founding refuge states.
    • Elvennrin — Surviving elven realm in Central Erisdar.
    • Elvenkrad — Elven state in North Erisdar.
    • Luzia / Maemon — Elven refuge and spiritual homeland on Merratodoni.
    • New Elvengar — Restoration attempt on Kutten.
    • Fallen Elves — Splinter group that retreated into the Mystical Forest.
    • Barro and Kob — Elven/halfling island nation on Merratodoni.
